item.title: Democratic Sen. Klobuchar says she's running for Minnesota governor after Gov. Walz dropped out

item.title: Houston drivers warned: Avoid hot water on icy windshields
item.description: Drivers in Houston are being reminded to use safe methods for removing ice from their windshields, such as using a plastic ice scraper and allowing the vehicle to warm up gradually, and to avoid using hot water which can cause the glass to crack or shatter.

item.title: Crews rescue cold-stunned sea turtles off Texas coast
item.description: Crews in Texas work to rescue cold-stunned sea turtles from the coast as extreme cold weather hits. Turtles are rehabilitated before release.

item.title: Houston: Mild temperatures in the 60s, cold front on the way
item.description: This week will be dry and mild with temperatures reaching the upper 60s, but another front will move in over the weekend bringing cold temperatures and overnight lows in the 30s and 20s.

item.title: Harris County property owners urged to pay taxes by Jan. 31 deadline
item.description: Property owners are being urged to make their property tax payments by the Jan. 31 deadline to avoid penalties and interest.

item.title: Houston community to hold peaceful anti-ICE demonstration Friday
